what: Breakout app.breakoutprop.com: fingerprint hardening is MEASURED DEAD on the ISP proxy (AS7849 US). Real Chrome 154 headed, persistent profile, webdriver=False, timezone matched, and patchright all got the same first-response 403 interactive Turnstile as baseline (run 37186023422), so the challenge is decided by address class before the browser is scored. Two questions remain open: does ONE human click clear it on this proxy address, and how long does cf_clearance last. Proposed next measurement, $0 and no VM: a GitHub runner behind the same proxy, with a 15-min noVNC link; the operator taps the link and clicks once; the runner reloads every 15 min for up to 5 h. Build the VM version (Tier-2, design in the memo §2) only if the lifetime is hours or more.
